name: restate/monorepo
description: Development repository of the Restate PHP SDK packages (packages/*); never published.

test:integration:external: phpunit tests/Integration --exclude-group managed --exclude-group large-bodies --exclude-group serving-hazards --exclude-group failure-nightly --exclude-group scale --exclude-group release

scripts-descriptions.test: Build the extension, then run the unit suite (its `extension` group runs the extension in child processes).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Build the extension, then run the suite against a real Restate container.
scripts-descriptions.test:scale: Build the extension, then run the scale tests' large cases (PHPUnit group `scale`, excluded from test:integration; nightly): long journals, wide fan-out, wide state, contention. RESTATE_PHP_TEST_SCALE_REPORT=<file> appends the measurements as JSON lines.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:restate-1.7: The integration suite against Restate 1.7.14 (best-effort server version, protocol v6).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:process: The integration suite (tests/Integration) with Restate as a process of the harness (restate-server from the dev shell) instead of a container: no container runtime needed, macOS included. examples/testing shows the default, a container, so it is left out.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:external: The integration suite (tests/Integration) against a Restate and an endpoint that run outside the harness, which only connects to them: those of a devenv.nix profile (`devenv --profile frankenphp test`, or `devenv --profile frankenphp up` and this in its shell). The tests that start, stop or configure either themselves (group `managed`) and the groups test:integration excludes are left out.
scripts-descriptions.test:frankenphp: Build the FrankenPHP image with the thread-safe extension, then run the integration suite against it.
scripts-descriptions.test:soak: Build the FrankenPHP worker images with the extension's diagnostics feature and run the soak suite (tests/Soak); arguments: [--quick] [nightly|frames|concurrency|bailout|restate|all] [-- <phpunit arguments>], see `just test soak` (tests/justfile).
scripts-descriptions.test:frankenphp-worker: The same image in FrankenPHP worker mode (endpoints built once per worker): the integration suite, then the worker suite (tests/Worker).
scripts-descriptions.test:fpm: Build the PHP-FPM image (nginx, Caddy), then run the integration suite against php-fpm behind each front door (RESTATE_PHP_TEST_SERVER: nginx-fpm, nginx-fpm-h2c, caddy-fpm; default all three).
scripts-descriptions.test:large-bodies: The nightly large-bodies group (31 MiB inputs and outputs, values over Restate's message limit) on php -S; for FPM: RESTATE_PHP_TEST_SERVER=<server> just test fpm --group large-bodies.
scripts-descriptions.test:failure: The nightly failure-nightly group (Restate restarts, graceful shutdowns, network faults, back-pressure, OOM kills, expired request identity, the full truncation sweep) on php -S; for FPM: RESTATE_PHP_TEST_SERVER=<server> just test fpm --group failure-nightly.
scripts-descriptions.test:serving-hazards: Build the PHP-FPM image with Apache, then run the nightly serving-hazards group: front doors at their defaults, front-door timeouts, clear_env.
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything that must pass before a commit: cs, analyse, workflow and shell lint, unit tests, the packages' composer.json files, then fmt/clippy/test for the Cargo workspace.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: PHPStan over the packages and the tests (phpstan.neon).
scripts-descriptions.cs: Check the coding style with php-cs-fixer (.php-cs-fixer.dist.php) and show the diff; changes nothing.
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Fix the coding style with php-cs-fixer (.php-cs-fixer.dist.php).
scripts-descriptions.check:scripts: actionlint on .github/workflows, shellcheck on the shell scripts and just --fmt --check on the justfiles (all from the dev shell).
scripts-descriptions.check:packages: composer validate --strict for each package in packages/, its code against its requirements (shipmonk/composer-dependency-analyser, with the extension loaded), the root composer.json against the packages, and that no package declares anything in the extension's Restate\Extension\ namespace (bin/check-packages.php).
scripts-descriptions.build:extension: Build the PHP extension (debug) into extension/target/debug/; pass `--release` or `--php-config <path>` after `--` (`just extension build`, see extension/justfile).
scripts-descriptions.release:split: Split the published directories into their repositories as a release does (see bin/split.sh): `list`, `split [<directory>...]` (the split commits of HEAD), or `publish [--version X.Y.Z] --remote <url with {repository}> [--dry-run]` (without a version: main only, as every push to main does), e.g. a dry run against https://github.com/restate-php/{repository}.git, or a rehearsal against local bare repositories.
scripts-descriptions.test:release: bin/split.sh on a throwaway monorepo pushing to local bare repositories: a release, a re-run, the next release, a push to main, a release of a commit later pushes passed, and the runs that must stop (tests/Unit/Release; part of composer check).
scripts-descriptions.build:pie: Cross-compile the 24 prebuilt binaries of a release with Nix (the packages.pie of extension/flake.nix) and copy the PIE archives, their .sha256 files and SHA256SUMS into dist/, or the directory given after `--` (`just extension pie [<dir>]`, see extension/justfile).
scripts-descriptions.check:extension: cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings and cargo test for every crate in extension/ (needs the dev shell for the extension build).
scripts-descriptions.serve: Build the extension, then serve test-services/index.php (every test service) on 0.0.0.0:9080 with it loaded.
scripts-descriptions.test:upstream: Build a test-services image and run the upstream Restate SDK test suite against it (Java 25: the dev shell); arguments: [target] [basic|full], see bin/conformance-upstream-local.sh.
scripts-descriptions.bench: Build the release extension, then run the PHP micro-benchmarks (tests/Benchmark, phpbench.json: OPcache on, JIT off); arguments go to phpbench, e.g. -- --filter=benchReplay.
scripts-descriptions.bench:compare: Compare the PHP benchmarks of this checkout against a base revision (default: the merge base with main) in two reversed pairs plus callgrind instruction counts; see bin/bench-compare.sh.
scripts-descriptions.bench:extension: Instruction counts (gungraun, callgrind) of the Rust core's benchmarks plus the replay linearity check; arguments go to gungraun's runner (`just extension bench`); `just extension bench-criterion` for wall-clock times, `just extension bench-compare [<base>]` against a base revision (extension/justfile).
scripts-descriptions.load: Load tests against Restate with k6: `just load run` [--full] [--keep] [<scenario>...], all of them when none is named (tests/load/justfile; `just load down` removes the compose project; needs Docker with compose, k6 and jq; see TESTING.md, Load tests).
